title: Audit exact total tape traffic for high-field doubling and halving
body:
## Summary

```text
research/high-scaling-total-traffic/
  PROOF.md                 exact all-parameter local traffic invoice
  traffic.py               independent closed formula
  source.py + observe.py   authenticated literal execution and origin tracking
  verify.py + tests        complete receipts and rejection controls
```

Independently audit PR2915's `kernels.doubled`. For odd Q>=3 and positive canonical spectator extents B,S, doubling and halving have the same exact logical tape traffic, including Count setup, every countdown, copies, rewinds and cleanup. The written source-level bound is `T<1024 BQS`. The exact construction count supplies a separately charged factory interface `T+aA`; allocator work is not assumed free.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml for the algorithm/caller, David Arias for the all-size caller, and Arham Tahir/PR2877 for the shared countdown identity. Their source lineage and exact heads are retained. This adds the independent scaling composition and checker, not another algorithm or kappa.

Base `3aa52a3b2f8c08994978f97d98c62cfa8e4916fb`, priority revision 5. All fourteen provenance/input rows match refreshed main `389fa10d714f5b40afe624908e487eb5e424498d`; the patch applies there. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18974953).

## Evidence

- Before, PR2915 provides the implementation, finite endpoints and a linear-cost argument. After, this separately derived exact invoice matches 390 complete literal calls and all 152,352 payload origins in both directions, plus 45 shared-countdown cases.
- An endpoint-preserving extra-countdown mutant raises 10,354 operations to 49,874. The exact invoice rejects its 39,520 excess. Wrong-direction, omitted-cleanup, malformed-input, source/receipt and canonical-width controls also pass.
- `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/high-scaling-total-traffic` passes all three registered commands, including optimized acceptance and thirteen behavioral groups. Optimized CPython3.13.5 replay/tests also pass on Linux/WSL2.
- All 144 research-workflow tests pass without skips. Strict lint/format, exact staged diff and the 23-file committed-byte preflight pass.

Successful local source-slice evidence only. Physical allocation/placement, complete routes/caller, failure-path cleanup, supplier admission, human/formal review and hosted CI are not established. Selected result and frozen inputs are unchanged. Substantial automated assistance; author-checked evidence.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Remove the isolated package to revert.

**Blast Radius:** research. The opt-in replay adds no production or selected-frontier changes.
